verdict.rationale: Superset exposes a broad programmatic surface: the CLI drives the same backend as the desktop app, and a TypeScript SDK, a live hosted MCP server and a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec cover workspaces, tasks, projects, automations, agents, terminals and hosts. Several UI features have no documented API equivalent, though, and nothing states that the API matches everything the UI can do. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement; programmatic equivalents for diff review and stage/commit/push/Create PR; Design-pane element-to-agent handoff; PR line-comment feedback to agents; design/report sharing and comments; independent corroboration of parity.
